current_point.claim: 提出了一种新的基于边分割的图流划分算法——Sketch-DBH，用于处理大规模图流数据下的子图划分问题。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a new edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm - Sketch-DBH, for handling subgraph partitioning problems in large-scale graph stream data.
technical_features: 通过Count-Min Sketch这一概率数据结构存储每个节点的度数信息，并使用一个最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息。
可以在常数时间内返回查询结果并据此生成单条图流数据即将被分配到的子图编号。
technical_features_en: Storing degree information of each node using Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure and maintaining high-frequency node information of graph stream data using a minimum heap.
Returning query results in constant time and generating the subgraph number for a single graph stream data to be allocated based on this information.
